THE PROFIT YOU DO NOT SEE

10 places where your bar
may be losing money.

These are examples of what the Mystery Guest Bar Audit looks for. How many happen in your bar?

  1. 01 / 10

    One pour too many. Margin too thin.

    Free pouring makes the cost of every drink unpredictable. The excess repeats, glass after glass.

    How to fix it

    Standardise measures and use a jigger.

  2. 02 / 10

    High sales. Little left over.

    Without drink specifications, you may sell cocktails without knowing what each one really costs.

    How to fix it

    Calculate the full cost of every recipe.

  3. 03 / 10

    Your neighbour’s prices do not pay your bills.

    Copying prices ignores your costs, your service and the margin you need.

    How to fix it

    Set prices based on cost and the value you deliver.

  4. 04 / 10

    Waste ends up on the bill too.

    Over-cut fruit, forgotten juices and excess prep add up to losses.

    How to fix it

    Prep to forecast demand and record waste.

  5. 05 / 10

    Without stock counts, losses hide.

    Without matching stock to sales, over-pours, comps and breakages go unnoticed.

    How to fix it

    Count stock and compare actual usage with expected usage.

  6. 06 / 10

    Idle bottles. Trapped cash.

    Buying products that barely sell ties up cash and takes up space.

    How to fix it

    Set purchasing and quantities by each product’s rotation.

  7. 07 / 10

    Does your menu know how to sell?

    Hiding high-margin, high-demand drinks wastes the potential of every order.

    How to fix it

    Highlight profitable choices with clear descriptions.

  8. 08 / 10

    The team serves. But can it recommend?

    Simply taking orders leaves choices unexplored that guests would value.

    How to fix it

    Train relevant suggestions, with clear prices and no pressure.

  9. 09 / 10

    Every minute of waiting can cost a sale.

    Poor prep and a disorganised station slow service at peak times.

    How to fix it

    Set up the station before opening and simplify movements.

  10. 10 / 10

    The wrong shift costs money.

    Too many staff in quiet hours and too few at peaks raise costs and lose sales.

    How to fix it

    Match shifts to demand and to the tasks of each period.

YOUR BAR IN NUMBERS

Small leaks.
Serious money by year end.

Two examples with round numbers. Change the values in the calculator to see your own bar.

01

One extra measure in every gin

  1. 2 cl over per gin × 40 gins a day × 30 days = 24 litres a month
  2. 24 litres is about 34 bottles of 70 cl
  3. At €12 to €17.50 a bottle, in product cost alone

€400 to €600 a month

€4,800 to €7,200 a year, without selling a single extra drink.

02

1 in 5 guests orders one more drink

  1. 200 guests a day (assumed) × 1 in 5 = 40 extra drinks a day
  2. 40 drinks × €10 = €400 a day
  3. €400 × 30 days

€12,000 a month

€72,000 over a 180-day season, in revenue before costs. That is what a good recommendation does.

Illustrative examples with assumed values. They are not client results.

Over-pouring: drinks per day × extra cl ÷ 70 × bottle cost × days. Recommendation: guests per day × % × price × days. Over-pouring is product cost; recommendation is revenue before costs.

PRACTICAL QUESTIONS

Before you
move forward.

What is the difference between the Mystery Guest Bar Audit and the Full Audit?+

The Mystery Guest Bar Audit is a fixed-price diagnosis: one day as a guest, one day with management and the team, and a report with improvement opportunities organised by impact, from €990 + travel, depending on the country. The Full Audit is a tailored project with agreed objectives, an itemised quote and implementation on the ground: menus, QR menu, screens, training, a team on site and more.

What does the Mystery Guest Bar Audit include?+

An assessment of 1 bar over two days: the first as a guest, without the team knowing who we are; the second with management and the team. At the end of the visit we present the first findings. The full report follows within 7 days, with opportunities organised by impact, urgency and ease of implementation. From €990 depending on the country; travel is extra and agreed in advance. Implementation is part of the Full Audit.

How does the guarantee work?+

We add up the estimated monthly value of every opportunity we identify: sales that did not happen, waste and avoidable costs. If the total does not reach €990 a month, we refund the audit fee. Every estimate shows the calculation and assumptions. Agreed travel costs are non-refundable.

Do I need the Mystery Guest before the Full Audit?+

It is not mandatory, but it is the recommended route: the diagnosis shows where the priorities are. If you go ahead within 30 days, the audit fee is deducted from the quote.

What results should we expect?+

We define indicators around your operation: contribution margin, average spend, waste, consistency or service times. Outcomes depend on demand, resources and execution; we do not guarantee profits or revenue increases.

Where do you work?+

In luxury hotels across Southern Europe’s leading destinations: Portugal (the Algarve, Lisbon, Madeira and the Azores), Spain (the Balearics, the Canaries, Costa del Sol, Costa Blanca, Barcelona and Madrid), Andorra, the Côte d’Azur and Monaco, Switzerland (Alpine resorts and lakes) and Italy (the Amalfi Coast, Capri, Sardinia, Sicily, Tuscany and the lakes). The Mystery Guest Bar Audit starts from €990; the final fee depends on the country and is confirmed in writing before booking, as is travel. You can get in touch in Portuguese, Spanish, English or French.

How does the Full Audit start?+

With a WhatsApp message or the form, and no obligation. Tell us about the bar and your objectives; we reply in writing and see whether it makes sense to go ahead. You then receive an itemised quote. The recommended route is to start with the Mystery Guest Bar Audit, which is deducted if you go ahead within 30 days.
